strategy.timing: guest sys_time immediately around HDK get_links; sample 0 is first pair, excluded from repeated statistics
strategy.order: default/local alternates pair order each sample; local_repeated follows alternating phase
strategy.population: normal full Core Schema bootstrap; single-agent local-only SweetConductor; no benchmark writes

cost_controls: Native controls use the same get_read_txn API and GetLinksQuery SQL on each store separately; they do not instrument the actual HDK invocation. Acquisition combines semaphore and connection-pool waiting. Timings include first-read sample 0, excluded from statistics.

database_population.sql:
SELECT Action.blob AS action_blob FROM DhtOp
            JOIN Action On DhtOp.action_hash = Action.hash
            WHERE DhtOp.type = :create
            AND
            Action.base_hash = :base_hash
            AND
            DhtOp.validation_status = :status
            AND DhtOp.when_integrated IS NOT NULL
              AND zome_index = 0 AND link_type = 1  
                    AND
                    HEX(Action.tag) like 'E282B755736564427956697375616C697A6572557361676500%' AND :after IS NULL AND :before IS NULL AND :author IS NULL UNION ALL 
            SELECT Action.blob AS action_blob FROM DhtOp
            JOIN Action On DhtOp.action_hash = Action.hash
            WHERE DhtOp.type = :delete
            AND
            Action.base_hash = :base_hash
            AND
            DhtOp.validation_status = :status
            AND
            DhtOp.when_integrated IS NOT NULL
